selection_rule: After excluding previously inspected a054_1, choose the three smallest compressed data members whose subject keys are disjoint. Assign ascending compressed size to development, validation-primary, validation-confirmatory.
subject_key_rule: Use the sequence-name prefix before the underscore as a conservative grouping key. The public inventory does not expose participant identity, so this prevents same-prefix leakage but does not prove demographic or device independence.

excluded.reason: Previously inspected diagnostic sequence; ineligible for development or validation selection.

lock_rules: Development raw inputs and truth may be inspected while designing and freezing the detector.
Validation archive members must not be fetched or opened until detector code, parameters, and ranking rules are committed.
Validation truth must not select or modify the detector, thresholds, resampling rate, stride gain, or evaluation gates.
Every validation result is reported; no sequence or rate may be silently dropped.
A validation failure may produce Stop or Narrow evidence but must not trigger tuning in this experiment version.
